_comment: Versioned emitter-output contract for silent-refusal lanes whose patterns were
read off wrapper SOURCE rather than observed logs [codex on orch#738]. Each line
is the verbatim echo template captured from the named script:line, with the
wrapper file's sha256 at capture. CI verifies the sentinel's regexes against
RENDERED forms of these templates (shell substitutions replaced), so a pattern
or contract edit that breaks matching fails CI everywhere. A separate skip-loud
local test detects drift between this contract and the live wrapper; the local
source pin is an ADDITIONAL check, not the proof.
captured: 2026-08-04 | weekly_wf_promote re-captured 2026-08-04 after RQ#568 (state-aware reject notify; +24 lines below :426)
